notes.title: Nostalgiarian is ready!
notes.notes:
Hello!

The big day is soon and we are ready for it!
Nostalgiarian will be live on January 5 and we have a 40% launch discount, valid for the first week!

So, don’t miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1192880/Nostalgiarian/

Also don't miss our trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4_BnqPQ_6YE
Nostalgiarian is an old school platform game which you can jump, climb, run, fight... Improve your reflexes. It is short game to casual gamers. In Nostalgiarian you will remember your childhood.

As always, thank you for your love and support.

Cheers, Cloaz Studio!
